newsitem.title: USA: Insurer AMERISAFE cuts IPO price range.
newsitem.headline: Insurer AMERISAFE cuts IPO price range.

text.p: AMERISAFE Inc cut the estimate pricing range for its planned initial public offering, according to a regulatory filing.

The Deridder, Louisiana company provides managed care workers' compensation products to employees in high risk occupations. It cut its estimated pricing range to $10 to $12 from its prior estimate of $13-$15, the filing said.
The company has proposed to trade on the NYSE under the symbol "ASF".
The IPO is expected to price tomorrow for trading on Wednesday, according to lead underwriter Smith Barney.
